About SIS
Stockholm International School is a truly international K-12 school located in the heart of the dynamic city of Stockholm. We are the first choice for the globally mobile diplomatic, business and research community in Sweden. Our students represent more than 60 countries and our diverse community is made up of over 80% international students and teaching staff. Our language of learning is English but our outlook is global.
Job Overview
Stockholm International School is seeking a Tech Support Specialist to join our dynamic IT Team and empower all SIS employees and students to do their best work. You will focus on removing technical barriers to productivity and learning  and finding creative solutions to new challenges. 
The IT Team at SIS is a flexible and agile team, responsible for a wide variety of services and processes and you will play a key role in removing technical barriers and delivering high-quality services to SIS employees and students. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing IT infrastructure, including managing a variety of cloud-based networking solutions, while ensuring the smooth daily operation of all IT systems. Your contributions will directly impact the learning experience at Stockholm International School, empowering students and staff through technology-driven solutions.
Duties/responsibilities
Manage, and maintain the school's cloud-based network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, stability, and security for both wired and wireless networks across the campus.
Troubleshoot network, infrastructure and hardware issues proactively, preventing downtime and ensuring the network runs smoothly. 
Leverage network automation tools to monitor and resolve issues before they impact users.
Assist in implementing and managing network security protocols.
Ensure the school’s digital environment adheres to secure networking best practices.
Leverage automation tools and network management solutions, to address potential issues and streamline IT operations.
Install, configure, and maintain a variety of devices (macOS, ChromeOS, Windows, iOS) across the network. 
Manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform, to streamline device deployments and ensure compliance with security policies.
Provide prompt, friendly, and effective support to students, teachers, and staff for their IT needs, ensuring technology enhances the learning and/or working experience.
Help teachers integrate technology into their classrooms by assisting with device setup (such as interactive displays, projectors, and mobile devices).
Offer student tech support, including assistance with educational devices (iPads, Chromebooks, Macbooks) and applications used in learning, such as Google Workspace and classroom-specific tools.
Assist in maintaining and troubleshooting IT resources for school events, such as assemblies, ensuring that audio-visual and conferencing systems work seamlessly.
Organize and run IT support drop-in sessions (Tech Bar) where students and staff can get help for technical issues or receive training on school systems and software.
Provide technical support for school events, including evening and weekend activities, as needed.

Qualifications, Attributes and Experience 
You have experience supporting macOS, ChromeOS, and Windows-based systems and enjoy providing personal support to help users solve technical problems.
You are familiar with network management tools, including Cisco Meraki or similar cloud-based networking platforms.
You have a basic understanding of Linux and have exposure to scripting and terminal use.
You are familiar with Mobile Device Management platforms.
You articulate yourself well in English, vocally and in writing
You have strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset and are able to work independently and collaboratively.
You are a curious person and a fast learner. You enjoy diving into new technologies and tools.
You have a degree or diploma (Yrkeshögskolan or equivalent) in computer science, management information systems, engineering, or a related field.
You are sensitive to cultural differences and eager to work in a diverse, multicultural environment.
You are able to prioritise and manage multiple cases effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points for
Experience working in a fast-paced school environment
Experience with Google Workplace, Jamf Pro and other applicable cloud services
Understanding of secure networking best practices
Working knowledge of Swedish.

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed, in line with the role and the needs of the organisation.
At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.
What we offer
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of: a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. 
Contract

Individually negotiated

We only accept applications in English and from qualified candidates.
Please send a letter of interest and your CV to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Tech Support Specialist”.

jobs.occupation: Business Area Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Information security is critical to achieving our strategic objectives and building resilient operations. As Business Area Chief Information Security Officer (BA CISO), you lead information security and resilience across Business Area Rock Processing, ensuring that security is embedded in business operations, IT and OT environments, and digital products.  
About the job 
You set the direction for information security across the Business Area and ensure that risks are effectively managed while legal, regulatory, customer and Sandvik requirements are met. Acting as principal advisor to Business Area Management, you connect strategic priorities with effective security governance and execution. You report to the Business Area VP IT & CIO.  
Job responsibilities 
Lead the Business Area security team and drive a strong security culture and awareness. 
Manage information security risks across IT, OT and digital products. 
Ensure and monitor compliance with Sandvik requirements, applicable laws and regulations, customer requirements and Business Area maturity targets. 
Advise Business Area Management on information security and cyber risk, and report on compliance to Business Area Management and the Sandvik CISO. 
Represent the Business Area in the Sandvik Information & IT Security Council and other relevant governance bodies.  

Location & flexibility 
This position is flexible within Europe, and regular international travel is expected. 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced information security leader with a strong track record from a large, international organization. Your background combines strategic security leadership with risk and compliance management across IT and OT environments, preferably including digital products.  
Your background includes: 
Extensive experience in information security leadership, risk management and compliance. 
Experience leading a team and advising and communicating with executive management. 
A university degree in information security, computer science, engineering or equivalent. 
Professional fluency in English. 
Strong capabilities in organizational leadership, change management, strategic planning and executive stakeholder management.  

Knowledge of information security laws, regulations and standards such as EU NIS2, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, the EU AI Act, ISO 27001 and IEC 62443 are an advantage, as is a recognized information security certification. 
Being strategic and confident in an executive setting, you combine strong communication skills with the ability to lead change and bring security perspectives into business decisions. You’re comfortable working across organizational boundaries and engaging stakeholders at multiple levels.  
The team 
You lead the Business Area security team and collaborate closely with Business Area Management, the Business Area CIO, the Sandvik CISO and owners of IT, OT and digital product environments. You also represent the Business Area in Sandvik-wide information security governance forums. 
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences.

jobs.occupation: Mandarin speaking Issue Resolution Engineer - Adaptive Test
jobs.description:
We are looking for a  Mandarin speaking Issue Resolution Engineer - Adaptive Test for a company in Gothenburg (Säve). Start is December 1st, 6 months limited contract to begin with, possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Säve).
 
The Test vehicles & logistics department is responsible for the test vehicles continuous life cycle during the development process.
The clients fleet consist of various types of vehicles and brands in the organization.
﻿ 
The department consists of four sub departments.
• senior advanced Fault tracer/SWDL.
• Vehicle management.
• vehicle fault tracer uptime engineer.
• Logistics and customs specialists.
• Adaptive testing
﻿ 
They are involved throughout the entire process, from planning & defining content to coordinating test vehicle build and usage, including material order to delivery tracking and to secure the latest SW baseline. This is a cross functional team working closely to ensure the test vehicle usage is optimized and fit for test in accordance with the purpose of build.
The typical task of the Test vehicle team is to take on the issues raised by the users of the test vehicles at our client.
They are also performing adaptive testing on all vehicle programs in Europe before it can be ok to buy in designated markets.
﻿ 
The test vehicles are located at various locations depending on the test type. The majority is located at our workshop Site at Säve and Uni3 at Lindholmen, but test vehicles can also be at other proving grounds in Sweden, EU and US.
They secure that the fleet is ready when going out on tests.
Team located at Test Site Säve, Gothenburg.
﻿ 
Description of the assignment
An issue resolution engineer is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and resolving technical issues that arise in various vehicle programs during adaptive testing. The role involves a structured approach to addressing issues, ensuring they are properly documented, analyzed, and resolved.
• Be a first point of contact with China counter party, (quality dept.)
• Lead SW and quality issues from issue identification to implementation and verification of solution.
• Using various techniques and tools to identify issues and analyze their root causes.
• Implementing sustainable solutions and preventing recurring issues.
• Implementing solutions: Evaluating and selecting solutions, implementing them, and verifying and validating the results.
• Collaborating with teams: Partnering with teams like product, operations, Quality and engineering to find permanent fixes.
• Contribute to implementation of agreed verification plans and test.
• Reporting test progress to the test leader and project team. But also identify and escalate verification risks to management
• Contribute to a culture of improvement and participating in implementing improvements to increase effectiveness and efficiency
﻿ 
Qualifications and skills required for the role
• B.Sc. Electrical or Computer Engineering or similar.
• Mandatory Mandarin (Chinese) speaking and writing.
• Fluent in English (Swedish is an advantage)
• 3 years’ experience in automotive embedded systems development
• Verification experience of automotive test or system development
• Capability to take on a wide range of tasks on different levels
• High communication skill and high collaboration’s ability
• Strong test analysis skills
• Valid Swedish drivers licence

Senior Java Engineer
Build the services. Own the outcome.
A concurrency bug that only appears under real load. A service that must stay available when a
dependency fails. Privacy guarantees that have to hold in production. These are the kinds of problems you will work through in this Java assignment.
Join 2MNordic for a long-term client assignment in a small, autonomous engineering team. 
Own services from design through production, influence the technical approach and build frameworks used across teams and by the developer community.
Why this role is worth your attention
• Ownership from design to production. Take a goal, work out the approach and see your service through delivery.
• Depth beyond the framework. Work with Java concurrency, memory behaviour and performance under real production load.
• Decisions with consequences. Design for availability, security and distributed failure modes, with privacy central to the system.
• Time to go deep. A long-term assignment gives you room to understand the domain and improve the services you build.
What you will build and improve
• Customer-facing web services that handle authentication, authorisation, spam control and demanding availability requirements.
• REST services using Netty or similar frameworks, backed by storage and caching technologies such as Cassandra, Redis and memcached.
• Distributed services designed around consistency, partitioning and failure recovery.
• Shared frameworks and reliable releases supported by automated testing and CI/CD.
How the team works
You will work across teams, manage dependencies and make technical decisions others can follow.
Priorities evolve as capabilities, security considerations and partner needs change. You should be comfortable adapting the plan, challenging assumptions and protecting quality as you do.

Bring your engineering judgement
You have built and scaled services for real users, debugged production failures and learned from the results. Typically, that means five or more years of experience; the depth of your work matters more than the number.
• Deep Java knowledge: the memory model, garbage collection behaviour and tuning, allocation pressure and java.util.concurrent beyond synchronised blocks. You can explain when to use virtual threads versus classic reactive models.
• Production debugging: experience investigating problems that only appear under real load or concurrency, and reading dependency source code when documentation is no longer enough.
• Service engineering: authentication, authorisation, availability, abuse prevention, reliability and performance tuning under load.
• Distributed systems and data: sound reasoning about consistency, partitioning and failure modes, plus strong knowledge of Cassandra, Redis, memcached or comparable technologies.
• Reliable delivery: REST services with Netty or similar frameworks, automated testing and CI/CD tooling.
• Clear communication in English: explain technical decisions to engineers and non-engineers, write useful design documents and work through trade-offs across teams.
Experience that adds value
Cryptography knowledge is particularly valuable: PKCS, KMIP, X.509, AES, key derivation functions and certificate authorities. Key handling and privacy guarantees are central to the system.
Experience with ML systems, frameworks or algorithms is a bonus, as is familiarity with GitHub, Maven, Docker, Spinnaker and Kubernetes.
Your consultancy partner: 2MNordic
Founded in Sweden in 2001, 2MNordic helps companies turn technological complexity into operational capability. Our work spans software development, architecture, automation, AI and data.
This assignment brings that approach to hands-on backend engineering with our client in Malmö.
Explore our work at 2mnordic.com.
Let your work start the conversation
Send your CV or consultant profile, availability and a few lines about a difficult Java or distributed systems problem you helped solve.
Location matters: this is an onsite assignment in Malmö. Include your current location and whether you can commute or relocate. The working language is English.

Combining PlantDesigner models with field data, case studies and operational experience, you strengthen how we understand and improve process performance. 
 
You build process competence across the organization and support Sales Areas through the Global Process Expert Network. This includes coaching Global Process Experts, providing training and expertise when needed, and supporting sales representatives, resellers and internal partners in delivering performance solutions. 
 
You also contribute to new performance-related service offerings and ensure Flowsheet and Performance Guarantee approvals follow established procedures.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve complex problems.

A valid driver’s license.

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.
 

Your role

As a Business Control Production Huskvarna, you will play an important role and work with our programs and the operation as a whole. Your overall goal will be to generate a positive business impact, provide early indicators to management and secure that Saabs accounting rules are followed. In this role, you will report directly to the Head of Business Control, Fighter Core Capabilities, you will also be a key member of the Production Huskvarna management team and work closely together with the Production manager.
 
Your main responsibilities are:
Support the Production Manager in financial and strategic decisions to drive growth, margin expansion, and cash generation by providing data-driven insights for business decisions.
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. Identify issues, quantify impacts, and lead corrective actions to ensure accurate financial planning and reporting.
Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal policies. Oversee financial closing, maintain high data quality, and lead quarterly reviews. Monitor the balance sheet and control investments to drive capital efficiency.
Lead business cases, investment decisions, and pricing strategies. Identify risks and opportunities for improvement to support business development.
Drive financial transformation initiatives and promote data-driven decision-making through advanced analytics and digital finance capabilities.

 
As an employee at Saab you are part of creating a culture that enhances and promotes performance, innovation and transparency by coaching and developing others around you.
 

Your profile

We believe you possess strong business acumen and strategic awareness, complemented by a relevant academic degree and extensive experience in financial planning, analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Experience from a management team is meriting.
We are seeking a candidate with significant experience in business control who values honesty, integrity, and fairness. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a solution-oriented approach.
Effective communication, both verbally and in writing, in English and Swedish is essential for this role. You are a collaborative team player with excellent judgment and drive, leading by example and inspiring others. Your empathetic nature enables you to support and motivate your team, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and help where needed, building strong relationships within and across functions.
 
Qualifications:
Relevant academic degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
Relevant experience from production controlling
Proven experience in financial planning, analysis, budgeting, and reporting
Significant experience in business control and strategic decision-making
Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish
Collaboration, and relationship-building skills
Proven ability to drive change and inspire others
Above all, your proactive and positive attitude will be key to your success.

 
This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
 

What You Will Be a Part Of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
 
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
 
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As our Creator Marketing Coordinator, you will play a key role in the day-to-day execution of influencer marketing campaigns across multiple markets. Working closely with creator marketing specialists, agencies, creators, and internal stakeholders, you'll help ensure campaigns are delivered smoothly, on time, and aligned with our creative and business objectives. This is a hands-on coordination role suited for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities at once and solving challenges along the way. 
Take part in the planning, organization, and execution of creator marketing campaigns.  
Ensure all necessary materials and assets are provided to creators and agencies, and campaigns are launched on schedule. Review influencer content to ensure it meets brand guidelines and campaign objectives before publishing.  
Serve as the primary point of contact between the brand, agencies, and creators. Manage communications, briefings, and approvals, ensuring expectations and timelines are clear and adhered to.  
Monitor and support live campaigns, helping track campaign performance and key metrics while identifying opportunities for optimization and improvement.   
Assist in managing campaign budgets, tracking expenses, and ensuring cost-effective use of resources. Liaise with finance and legal teams on contracts and payments as needed.  
Maintain and nurture relationships with creators, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to deliver their best work for the brand. Assist in identifying new creators for future partnerships.  
Act as the first line of support to resolve any campaign-related issues that arise with influencers or agencies, from delays to miscommunications or content concerns. 
 

 
WHO YOU ARE  
We are looking for people with…  
Experience working with influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media campaigns or similar marketing activations in the US, with great understanding of SoMe platforms such as TikTok and Instagram.   
Passionate about staying up to date with social media trends and a strong understanding of the younger audience and what creates engaging activations.   
Comfortable working with campaign data, reporting, and performance tracking.   
Experience working with the US market and/or exposure to affiliate marketing are considered advantages.   
Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.   
 

And people who are…  
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. You are proactive, solution-oriented and enjoy finding ways to make things happen.   
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Able to structure and manage large volumes of deliverables, parallel campaigns, and reporting thereof.  
You thrive while juggling multiple projects and deliverables at the same time, maintaining calm and good judgment. 
 

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.  
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Are you curious about how new technology can improve customer service in practice? Join our Dynamics Product team and combine business analysis with hands-on exploration of Dynamics 365 Customer Service, data and AI-related capabilities.  
With us, you get to take ideas from “could this help?” to tested examples and clear recommendations, helping our service teams create a consistent and effective customer experience across email, chat and voice.  
Your mission 
We run the Dynamics 365 Customer Service solution across Sandvik Coromant and our sister divisions. Working closely with users and stakeholders, you explore needs, analyze usage and help determine what the team should develop next and why. You belong to a cross-functional product team and collaborate throughout the full delivery process. 
Job responsibilities 
Work with users and stakeholders across divisions to understand their needs, processes and underlying challenges.  
Explore new Dynamics 365 capabilities, test AI agents and create small proofs of concept.  
Query data and build reports to understand usage, identify problems and evaluate improvements. 
Support prioritization by assessing business value, effort and risk. 
Translate findings into user stories and acceptance criteria, working with developers, testers and architects.  
Support testing and adoption, prepare training material and maintain functional documentation. 

 
Location and flexibility 
The preferred location for this position is Sandviken, Sweden. Solna, Sweden or Pune, India could also be an option.  We offer a hybrid solution, with the possibility to work some days from home.  
Your profile 
You have a university degree in IT or related field, or the equivalent practical experience, together with several years of experience from a relevant position. A solid understanding of customer service operations helps you distinguish between what users ask for and the underlying problems they need to solve.  
Your background includes 
Experience in business analysis and translating business needs into clear requirements.  
Confidence working directly on digital platforms and learning through experimentation. 
The ability to query data and create reports independently. 
Strong communication skills in English.  
Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service and AI agents is a strong advantage.  

Curious and practical, you enjoy moving between user conversations, data analysis and hands-on testing. You communicate complex topics clearly, challenge assumptions constructively and feel confident to recommend against a feature when it doesn’t solve the actual problem.  
The team 
You join a small, cross-functional product team of business analysts, testers and developers. Together, you work in an agile setup with short sprints and collaborate with users and stakeholders across divisions.  
Our culture 
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment.
